issues.explanation: Chapter 30 says Zhang He and Gao Lan defect to Cao Cao, but Chapter 31 presents Gao Lan and Zhang He as Yuan Shao's active commanders without explaining their return. Gao Lan even kills Liu Pi before Zhao Yun kills him.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify that Gao Lan and Zhang He later returned to Yuan Shao, or change Chapter 31 so they remain Cao Cao's officers and use different Yuan commanders.
